BEFORE YOUR NEXT VISIT

SMALL DETAILS.
A CLEARER NEXT STEP.

KNOW YOUR RACKET

Know your racket

Record the make, model and any manufacturer guidance printed on the frame. Point out visible damage before any work is agreed.

DESCRIBE THE FEEL

Describe the feel

Share your current grip and strings if known, and what you would like to change about comfort or feel.

CONFIRM THE WORK

Confirm the work

Ask the specialist to confirm suitable options, manufacturer limits, price and collection time before proceeding.

COME PREPARED

WHAT TO BRING.

  • Your racket and model details
  • Current string and grip information
  • Your preferences and any damage concerns

Good questions.

Can I book restringing on this website?

Online booking is not connected. Contact or visit the store to confirm whether the service is available and agree a time.

What tension should I choose?

Discuss it with a suitable specialist, using the racket manufacturer’s recommended limits. This page does not prescribe a tension.
